channel.title: Cobble Updates
channel.description: Signed Full releases of Cobble for macOS.

item.description:
Full Cobble browser for Apple silicon and macOS 26+.
- Command-clicking a link in a WebKit tab now opens the destination through Automatic engine selection. - Cross-engine destinations open in the configured engine; same-engine child tabs keep their live WebKit page.
Includes WebKit, Chromium and signed in-app updates. Uses the pinned public ABI 18 SDK and its matching Chromium runtime.
This is an early beta. Interrupted download recovery, real-account authentication, clean-Mac installation and installed version-to-version updates remain unqualified.
Download the ZIP, extract Cobble, quit the old app and replace it in Applications. Beta 1 users need one manual install because that version's updater cannot start.

Full Cobble browser for Apple silicon and macOS 26+.
- Space swipes follow gesture distance directly and avoid rebuilding the entire sidebar during movement. - Already-open tabs appear as soon as you release a space swipe, preserving their live document and unsaved form state. - Cold page creation waits until the sidebar has settled and drawn, keeping engine startup out of the visible slide. - The development Run menu preserves the configured remote Mac, signing team and Xcode settings across worktrees.
Includes WebKit, Chromium and signed in-app updates. Uses the pinned public ABI 17 SDK and its matching Chromium runtime.

Full Cobble browser for Apple silicon and macOS 26+.
- Switching from a Chromium page to an empty space keeps the space empty without automatically focusing sidebar search. - Command-Shift-R performs Force Reload; Command-R remains normal reload. Chromium bypasses its cache and WebKit revalidates cached resources. Cookies and website data are preserved. - Site controls now use full-width action buttons and matching security/page-action controls. One counted Certificate button expands certificate details. - Downloads show native file icons and clearer filenames. Browser separators are translucent white and folders show disclosure chevrons beside their titles. - WebKit supports native fullscreen video playback. - Mail links ask for confirmation before opening an external application.
